source_of_truth: Operator-approved v0 design captured in project_skill_applicability_v0.md memory and this plan's D001-D007 decisions. The feature is an advisory lock-time sidecar, not a central router or gate.

user_journeys.name: plan-author-declares-surfaces
user_journeys.description: A plan author marks a plan with the surfaces it touches using the canonical optional surfaces field. Existing plans without the field still validate and load with an empty surface list.
acceptance_signals: Valid surfaces reach LoadedPlan as a list
Invalid surface values fail schema validation clearly

user_journeys.name: skill-author-self-declares-applicability
user_journeys.description: A skill author adds applies_to frontmatter to SKILL.md declaring applicable surfaces and goal types. The skill may also declare inert external_cli metadata for an externally-backed adapter. The matcher validates the block, skips missing or malformed declarations, and does not require a central router update.
acceptance_signals: Valid applies_to declarations can match a plan
Valid external_cli metadata is copied into a match as provenance without execution
Missing declarations produce a non-blocking skip
Malformed declarations produce a non-blocking parse skip

user_journeys.name: operator-reviews-advisory-sidecar
user_journeys.description: When a plan locks, DontPanic writes evidence/applicable-skills.json with matched skills and skip rationale. The operator sees a one-line summary and can decide manually whether any matched skill should be invoked.
acceptance_signals: Lock never fails solely because the matcher has no matches
Sidecar has stable JSON round-trip shape
Matcher failures are best-effort and do not block lock

user_journeys.name: ux-plan-surfaces-design-review-signal
user_journeys.description: A UI or product-journey plan that declares ux or web surfaces receives at least one relevant UX-capable skill match from the demonstrative backfill, making the original design-review gap visible at lock time.
acceptance_signals: At least one backfilled skill declares ux applicability
A surfaces=[ux] fixture produces a real match
No hard gate requires the operator to invoke the matched skill

required_evidence: Validator output showing the plan schema accepts valid surfaces, rejects invalid surfaces, and remains backward-compatible when surfaces is missing
Unit test output for match correctness, missing applies_to skip, malformed applies_to skip, empty-surfaces behavior, and JSON round-trip
Unit test output showing external_cli metadata is validated and copied into the report without invoking the command
Manual or automated lock-time proof that evidence/applicable-skills.json is written after a successful lock
Fixture or backfilled-plan proof that a ux-surface plan produces at least one UX-capable skill match
non_goals: No hard gate based on matched skills
No scope-change re-probe during an active volley
No exhaustive backfill across every plan or every skill
No Printing Press or other external CLI install, invocation, allowlisting, binary hashing, or live provenance validation
completion_test: A plan with declared surfaces can lock successfully and produce an advisory applicable-skills sidecar that highlights relevant self-declared skills, including a UX-capable match for a UX/product-journey plan and inert external CLI provenance when declared, while preserving backward compatibility and never blocking lock.
